import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem localCompactAt_iff_exists_compact_closed_interior {X : Type*}
  [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (x : X) :
  (∃ U : Set X, x ∈ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ (∃ K : Set X, U ⊆ K ∧ IsCompact K)) ↔
    ∃ K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ IsClosed K ∧ x ∈ interior K := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hxU, hU, K, hUK, hK⟩
    exact ⟨K, hK, hK.isClosed, interior_maximal hUK hU hxU⟩
  · rintro ⟨K, hK, -, hxK⟩
    exact ⟨interior K, hxK, isOpen_interior, K, interior_subset, hK⟩

import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem localCompactAt_iff_exists_compact_closed_interior {X : Type*}
  [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (x : X) :
  (∃ U : Set X, x ∈ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ (∃ K : Set X, U ⊆ K ∧ IsCompact K)) ↔
    ∃ K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ IsClosed K ∧ x ∈ interior K := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hxU, hUopen, K, hUK, hKcomp⟩
    have hKclosed : IsClosed K := hKcomp.isClosed
    have hU_sub_interior : U ⊆ interior K := interior_maximal hUK hUopen

    exact ⟨K, hKcomp, hKclosed, hx_interior⟩
  · rintro ⟨K, hKcomp, hKclosed, hx_interior⟩
    refine ⟨interior K, hx_interior, isOpen_interior, K, interior_subset, hKcomp⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem localCompactAt_iff_exists_compact_closed_interior {X : Type*}
  [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (x : X) :
  (∃ U : Set X, x ∈ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ (∃ K : Set X, U ⊆ K ∧ IsCompact K)) ↔
    ∃ K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ IsClosed K ∧ x ∈ interior K := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨U, hxU, hUopen, K, hUK, hKcomp⟩
    have hKclosed : IsClosed K := hKcomp.isClosed
    have hxinterior : x ∈ interior K := by
      have hU_sub_interior : U ⊆ interior K := interior_maximal hUK hUopen
      exact hU_sub_interior hxU
    exact ⟨K, hKcomp, hKclosed, hxinterior⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨K, hKcomp, hKclosed, hxinterior⟩
    have hUopen : IsOpen (interior K) := isOpen_interior
    have hxU : x ∈ interior K := hxinterior
    have hUK : interior K ⊆ K := interior_subset
    exact ⟨interior K, hxU, hUopen, K, hUK, hKcomp⟩
